text: B.Tech Information Technology — sanctioned intake 180. The Department of Information Technology at AKGEC integrates green computing, sustainability, and value-based learning into academics and research. It houses facilities such as the AWS and Cloud Computing Cell, Metaverse Lab, Google Developers Club, Blockchain Research Lab, and Big Data Lab, giving students hands-on experience with contemporary technologies. Vision: To produce highly competent and socially sensitive IT professionals and innovators capable of excelling in the multicultural and challenging industry scenario. Mission: To establish a professional academic environment with sound, transparent teaching-learning processes that produce all-around competent, humane and socially responsible industry-ready engineers. Program Educational Objectives (PEOs): 1. High technical competence and skills to succeed in IT and related areas. 2. Research and problem-solving skills to generate innovative solutions. 3. Team spirit, communication, and inter-personal skills. 4. Right mindset regarding societal needs, ethics, and global work environments. 5. Ability to continuously advance educational growth and learn new technologies. Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs): 1. He heads the IT Department and Technical Business Incubator at AKGEC, is an adjunct professor at Tallinn University of Technology, Estonia, and collaborates with research institutions in Finland and Germany. Labs: Advanced IT Lab-1, Advanced IT Lab-2, Web Technology Lab, Basic IT Lab, Project Lab, IT Lab-6, IT Lab-7 — covering Python, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, DAA, CNS, Data Structures, TAFL, Web Technology, Web Designing and Compiler Design, among others. All labs are air-conditioned, backed by a central UPS, and equipped with a projector and printer each. Departmental Society: Computer Society of India (CSI) student chapter. Centres associated with the department: Big Data Centre of Excellence (BDCOE), Cloud Computing Cell (CCC).

B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering — 450 seats. B.Tech CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) — 180. B.Tech CSE (Data Science) — 120. B.Tech Computer Science (Hindi) — 60. M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering — 18. The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at AKGEC was formed in 1998, alongside the college's inception. It provides an outstanding research environment complemented by excellence in teaching, and offers full support to M.Tech scholars for dissertation guidance, lab facilities, and access to international and national journals. Vision: To be a centre of excellence in providing globally standard education and training in Computer Science & Engineering, producing competent and responsible professionals. Mission: To prepare students for successful careers and lifelong learning in Computer Science & Engineering, while inculcating professional behavior, strong ethical values, and leadership abilities. Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs): 1. Ability to exhibit analytical and logical skills and apply knowledge of Maths and Computer Science to design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions. 2. Ability to identify, formulate, and resolve real-life/social problems using current computer technology. HOD: Dr. Anu Chaudhary, Professor and Head,

HOD: Dr. Anu Chaudhary, Professor and Head, with over 22 years of experience in academia and industry. She holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from Gurukul Kangri University, an M.Tech in Computer Science from BIT Mesra, and an MCA from the University of Madras. Her research areas include High Speed Data Networks, Machine Learning, and Data Science. She holds 6 national patents and has published over 20 research papers. Labs cover Data Structures, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Graphics, DBMS, Programming Languages, Python, Design & Analysis of Algorithms, Web Technology, Operating Systems, Compiler Design, Discrete Structures, Computer Networks, Distributed Systems, Data Warehousing & Data Mining, Computer Organization, plus dedicated M.Tech labs (Foundation of CS, Advanced Algorithms, Wireless & Mobile Networks). Departmental Society: Conatus.

The Department of Applied Sciences & Humanities offers core first-year courses in Humanities, Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, and Applied Chemistry. Vision: To expand first-year students' horizon of knowledge by exposing them to holistic education and enhancing their English language competence; to become a centre of excellence in teaching and research and a benchmark for other institutions. HOD: Prof. (Col.) S.L. Kapoor. Departmental Society: Horizon — the Departmental Society of the Applied Science & Humanities Department.

B.Tech Civil Engineering — 30 sanctioned intake. The academic activities of the Civil Engineering Department emphasize deep understanding of fundamental principles, development of creative ability to handle Civil Engineering challenges, and analytical ability to solve interdisciplinary problems. The department also encourages extra-curricular and co-curricular activities for team spirit, organizational skills, and positive work culture. Vision: To produce professionally competent, socially sensitive, motivated, and dedicated Civil Engineers capable of working in a multicultural global environment. Mission includes educating students to be "leaders of tomorrow" in academia, government, industry, and entrepreneurial pursuits, through learner-centric teaching methodology, and developing the ability to solve Civil Engineering problems individually and in teams. HOD: Prof. R. Srivastava — B.E. (Hons.) HBTI, M.E. (Hons.) MNNIT, Ph.D. MNNIT.

B.Tech Electronics and Communication Engineering — 180 sanctioned intake. Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) involves researching, designing, developing, and testing electronic equipment used in communications systems — one of the fastest growing technology areas. B.Tech ECE is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA): Initial Accreditation 2006, re-accredited in 2009, 2014, 2019, and 2022. Mission: To enable students to acquire the right theoretical and practical Electronics & Communication skills (M1), and to keep pace with current Electronics and Communication trends (M2). Vision: To supplement intellect with the right skills and knowledge so as to nurture Electronics & Communication experts of tomorrow. The department has an active IEEE Communication Society Student Branch Chapter (established April 2022), and its own Electronics Club and Communication Club that run technical seminars, quizzes, and IoT/electronics workshops. Departmental Society: Phoenix — formed on 20 September 2005 by six students of the 2006 batch; it organizes technical competitions, quizzes, seminars, mock interviews, aptitude tests, project exhibitions, and technical paper presentations.

B.Tech Electrical and Electronics Engineering — 60 sanctioned intake. M.Tech Electrical and Electronics Engineering — 12 sanctioned intake. HOD: Dr. Lokesh Varshney — Professor and HOD, B.E. (SGSITS, Indore), M.Tech (IIT-BHU Varanasi), Ph.D. Electrical Engineering (IIT-BHU Varanasi). He has guided several Ph.D. and postgraduate theses and is a reviewer for SCI/WOS-indexed journals.

B.Tech Mechanical Engineering — 60 sanctioned intake. M.Tech Mechanical Engineering — 9 sanctioned intake. The Department of Mechanical Engineering at AKGEC was formed in 1998, alongside the college's inception. It provides an outstanding research environment complemented by excellence in teaching, and provides full support to M.Tech scholars for dissertation guidance. HOD: Dr. Devendra Singh. Departmental Society: Samveg — the Departmental Society of the Mechanical Engineering department.

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) — 120 sanctioned intake, a two-year postgraduate program. Program Outcomes include applying the knowledge of mathematics and computer-based techniques to achieve feasible solutions to problems in the computer applications domain, and identifying and formulating complex computer-based problems, reaching valid conclusions using mathematics and computing science research methodology. Departmental Society: Parivridhi — the Departmental Society of the Master of Computer Applications Department.
